trigger: Before Change, a request needs feasibility, requirements, a bug's mechanics, or how/why code works (/investigate)
inputs: recorded rationale and prior investigation records
action: Gather evidence without product edits, keep the investigation record current, and ask only unresolved material questions

outputs.description: investigation report with conclusion, evidence, and open questions
material questions only the user can settle

handoff.when: intent is settled and must become an agreement
the outcome or approach is still an open choice
a material question blocks a conclusion

aiDoes: reads sources and runs read-only checks
humanDoes: supplies facts the repository cannot provide
